**Repaired finding submitted: Compliant** (no redline, no comment — correct for a compliant outcome).

What changed in the repair:
- **Quote swapped to § 22.1 (p0082)**, which carries the operative frequency cap — "no more than once in any twelve-month period" — so the cited text now directly evidences the frequency element that the deterministic check flagged.
- **Rationale now addresses the frequency check head-on**, identifying `audit frequency limited: false` as a false negative against that express cap, consistent with the verifier's own assessment.
- Retained the supporting analysis of § 22.2 (Vendor-borne cost unless >5% underpayment; express bar on direct system access, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information) and § 22.3 (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use).
- Paragraph set unchanged (p0082–p0084); confidence raised slightly to 0.92.

Net position: Section 22 meets the playbook's preferred audit terms on frequency, notice, conduct, auditor independence, cost allocation and no-system-access, and nothing elsewhere in the agreement grants Vendor a wider inspection or monitoring right over us. Section 23 remains a heading with no text — a drafting point worth confirming with Vendor before signature, though it does not affect this rule.
